You can visit a general medicine doctor if you are experiencing severe symptoms like:

A severe cold and cough, shortness of breath, and congestion.
A persistent fever (temperature over 102 degrees).
Severe pains in different body parts such as the chest, abdomen, or pelvis. These could cause serious conditions in the future, e.g., heart attack or gallstones.
Lack of energy and regular fatigue. These could be related to diseases like anemia or thyroid.

What is checked during a general exam?

Obesity based on the BMI

What Should Your HCG Level Be After Embryo Transfer?

After your embryo transfer, the Beta-hCG blood test is the moment of truth. But what do those numbers actually mean? India's leading IVF specialist, Dr. Firuza Parikh, breaks it down clearly.

📊 Key hCG levels to know after embryo transfer:
🔹 Less than 5 mIU/mL → Negative for pregnancy
🔹 Greater than 20 mIU/mL → Positive — pregnancy likely
🔹 Day 12 after transfer → hCG above 86.8 IU/mL is a positive predictor
🔹 Day 14 after transfer → Above 200 mIU/mL suggests a continuing pregnancy
🔹 Above 600 mIU/mL on Day 14 → May indicate multiple pregnancy (twins)

✅ What healthy hCG looks like:
→ hCG should double every 48 hours in early pregnancy
→ Levels are retested every 4th day until they reach 20,000 mIU/mL
→ Once 20,000 is reached, a transvaginal ultrasound is performed

⚠️ When to be cautious:
→ Slow-rising or falling hCG may suggest ectopic pregnancy or miscarriage risk
→ Always consult your specialist — numbers alone don't tell the full story

💡 Remember: The rate of rise matters more than a single hCG value.

Diagnosed with a bulky uterus and worried about your chances of conceiving? You're asking the right questions — and the answers may be more hopeful than you think.

A normal uterus measures approximately 7–8 cm long & 4 cm thick. When it enlarges beyond this due to an underlying condition, it's termed a "bulky uterus."

Your uterine lining is the very foundation of a successful pregnancy. When it's too thin, even the best embryo may struggle to implant.

At FertilTree – Jaslok Hospital, Mumbai, our specialists diagnose and treat thin endometrium with precision — giving your IVF cycle the best possible environment to succeed.

📏 What is "thin" endometrium?
An ideal uterine lining is 8mm to 12mm thick. Below 8mm significantly reduces implantation chances.

⚠️ Signs you may have a thin endometrial lining:
🔴 Difficulty conceiving or repeated IVF failures
🔴 Light or scanty menstrual bleeding
🔴 Irregular or unusually short periods
🔴 History of miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy

→ Low estrogen levels
→ Decreased blood flow to the uterus
→ Uterine infections (including TB-related)
→ Previous D&C, surgery or Caesarean section

featured_reviews.name: Varsha Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello, I’m Dr. Varsha. My pregnancy treatment was under the care of Dr. Amol Pawar, and I’m truly grateful for his exceptional guidance and support throughout my journey.

I had multiple complications during pregnancy, including a cystectomy in my second trimester, but Dr. Amol Pawar handled everything with great expertise and care. From the first trimester until delivery, he kept me under close observation and guided me regarding medications, diet, and activities to ensure both my baby’s and my safety.

Despite the complications and a planned C-section, everything was managed smoothly and confidently. He is not only an excellent gynecologist but also a wonderful and compassionate human being.

A heartfelt thanks to Dr. Amol Pawar and his entire team for their outstanding care and support.

featured_reviews.name: Vibha Bhirud
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had my daughter delivered at Nowrosjee Wadia Maternity Hospital under Dr. Amol Pawar, and as someone who went through the entire experience firsthand, I can say with complete confidence — I was in exceptional hands.

Dr. Pawar has a rare quality that is hard to find in a doctor: he made me feel genuinely heard and cared for, not just as a patient, but as a person going through one of the most vulnerable and momentous experiences of her life. His calm demeanor, clear communication, and steady expertise meant that even in the most anxious moments, I felt safe and reassured.

The delivery was smooth, and throughout the process, Dr. Pawar and the team at Nowrosjee Wadia ensured I was comfortable, informed, and well looked after at every stage. The care I received was thorough, compassionate, and deeply professional.

The hospital itself is clean, well-managed, and supported by a staff that genuinely understands the emotional weight of what families go through in a maternity setting.

I am now a proud mother, and a big part of that joy belongs to Dr. Amol Pawar and the wonderful team at Nowrosjee Wadia. If you are an expecting mother looking for a doctor who will truly take care of you, look no further. Highly, highly recommended.
